personal.name: Rudresh Singh
personal.title: Backend Developer & Deep Tech Engineer
bio: Building high-performance APIs, distributed systems, and data-intensive applications.
Working primarily with Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS, and systems-level C++.
Currently exploring Deep Learning, AI systems, and the engineering behind scalable ML infrastructure.
about: I like architecting things, designing systems, and connecting patterns between technologies and domains that don't initially seem related.

My biggest strength isn't a specific framework or language — it's adaptability. I'm comfortable moving across technologies, learning what's necessary, and turning unfamiliar ideas into working systems.

I learn best by building. Whether it's a backend service, distributed pipeline, data system, or machine learning model, I prefer understanding what happens underneath the abstraction rather than simply using the abstraction.
For me, growth comes from building, breaking, understanding, shipping, and repeating the process.

projects.name: Bodh Ecosystem
projects.description: High-throughput Indian News Intelligence Engine combining automated data ingestion, transcript scraping, analytics, caching, and a production REST API deployed on AWS.
highlights: Reduced API query latency from roughly 1–2 seconds to under 80ms using Redis TTL caching and optimized database access
Designed PostgreSQL data access using GIN, BRIN, JSONB, and Full-Text Search across partitioned datasets
Built a custom Redis Lua-script Token Bucket rate limiter supporting per-minute and daily API quotas
Designed a Docker internal network isolating PostgreSQL and Redis from public access
Configured Nginx as a reverse proxy with IP-based rate limiting for sensitive endpoints
Built an autonomous ingestion pipeline using Playwright and BullMQ for scheduled transcript scraping and processing
Integrated dbmate migrations into the Docker Compose application lifecycle
Designed the system around constrained AWS infrastructure with explicit memory and service-isolation considerations

projects.description: Low-level concurrent TCP chat server built from the socket layer to understand networking, concurrency, and client-server communication without relying on high-level networking frameworks.
